no_adcom_quote.quote: No Oncology Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) Meeting or other external consultations are required for the current application for givosiran for the treatment of AHP.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the GIVLAARI (givosiran) NDA212194 approval. The Multidiscipline Review, Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations), explicitly states that no ODAC meeting or other external consultations were required for this application. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
